278671679.description: This lot includes five vintage tobacco pipes from brands like Kaywoodie, Parker, and Five-Nine-Teen. The pipes are made of wood with hard rubber or plastic stems, each showing varying shapes and lengths. There are visible signs of wear including chipping, bite marks, and discoloration on the stems and mouthpieces, with one mouthpiece detached. Each pipe is marked with its brand name, indicating authenticity.

278687933.description: A variety of crystals and stones including quartz points, rose quartz pieces, polished agate, citrine cluster, and other minerals. Includes both natural and polished specimens.

279450752.description:
Long curved metal smoking pipe with a bowl shaped like the head of an elephant. The trunk curves upward and holds a small hanging cone charm, and the lidded bowl has coiled wire detail. The stem is decorated with filigree wirework, flower motifs, rope style bands and an open basket shaped bead. The finish is silver tone.

Condition: Tarnish and darkened patina throughout. Green residue near the base of the trunk. Light scratches and marks along the stem. Some wirework is slightly bent. Mouthpiece tip shows wear.

: Dive into nostalgia with this large collection of vintage POGs milk caps and slammers, conveniently stored in two labeled tubes. Featuring a vibrant assortment of round cardboard POGs and several metal and plastic slammers, this lot showcases a colorful variety of fun designs, including cartoons, sports, holographic graphics, and bold patterns. Each piece is individually unique, capturing the energetic spirit of the 1990s playground craze. This collection contains a substantial number of caps and slammers, making it ideal for collectors, hobbyists, or anyone looking to relive classic game moments. The POGs and slammers exhibit evidence of regular handling, with some edge wear and minor surface scratches visible on certain pieces, which is typical for vintage game pieces played and enjoyed over the years. No original branding or manufacture year is shown, emphasizing a truly mixed assortment. Both storage tubes are included for convenient organization and display. A fantastic find for anyone wanting to expand their collection or introduce new players to this iconic game
